text: DSH Subagent Compactor 是 DSH Desktop 插件，可在父会话查看直接子智能体并手动压缩其历史。它注册 `/subagent-compact` 命令，以及 `compact_subagent`、`compact_all_subagents` 两个模型工具。用户可按会话 ID 压缩单个子成员，也可按目录快照逐个批量处理并查看回执。压缩调用组合提供的引擎，默认等待忙碌子成员空闲。

DSH Subagent Compactor compacts direct subagent history in DSH Desktop. Run `/subagent-compact <id>` or `compact_subagent` for one child; use `/subagent-compact --all` or `compact_all_subagents` for the child catalog. It returns outcomes and batch counts and uses the composition’s compaction engine.
想把某个子智能体较早的对话压成摘要，腾出上下文继续使用。
怎么查看当前父会话创建的直接子智能体并压缩其中一个？
I want to compact the older history of one of my direct subagents by its session ID.
DSH Subagent Compactor 的功能「按 ID 压缩子成员」：在父会话用 `/subagent-compact <id>` 或调用 `compact_subagent`，压缩指定直接子成员的历史并返回结果。
DSH Subagent Compactor 的功能「批量压缩」：在父会话用 `/subagent-compact --all` 或调用 `compact_all_subagents`，逐个处理目录中的直接子成员并返回结果计数。

text:
@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Use it：Use the command in the parent session that created the subagent:

```text
/subagent-compact
```

This lists the parent's persisted direct-child catalog (and, when the parent's latest batch did not complete cleanly, that batch's durable receipt — see below). Each line ends with `— live` (a loaded agent) or `— persisted (not loaded)` (a record whose agent is not loaded; a listing is an observation, not a reservation). Copy a full child session ID, then invoke:

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Use it：```text
/subagent-compact <subagent-session-id>
```

Two lawful situations:

- **Child still live** — invoke while it is running; the default `waitForIdle: true` waits for its turn to finish before compacting.
- **Child finished** (a continuable child that settled and was reclaimed) — invoke by id at any later time. The plugin restores the child, compacts once, and releases it; no new task is sent. The same id stays continuable afterwards.

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Batch: compact every direct child at once：Compacts every child in **one durable catalog snapshot** of the calling parent, taken when the run starts (children spawned afterwards belong to the next run; no recursion into grandchildren, no other parents' children). Items run **serially** under the same per-target locks — a concurrent single compaction of the same child reports `busy-target`. Each item reports its own outcome and reason (compacted with its summary seq / replaced items / replaced-history token estimate, nothing-to-compact, refused for unsupported mode or pending input, engine failure, …); one child's failure never hides the rest. The batch outcome is `completed` only when every child compacted or had nothing to compact, `all-failed` when nothing succeeded, `partial-failure` in between, and `batch-cancelled` when it was cancelled — including a cancellation that lands while the catalog read is still resolving; every non-clean outcome makes the command report an error, never success. Cancelling (or unloading the plugin) stops children that have not started yet — reported as `not-started` — and keeps every finished result; a catalog th
section: Batch: compact every direct child at once

text: @local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Batch: compact every direct child at once：Every finished batch persists one **receipt** — a schema-validated record in the plugin's own versioned **storage domain** (`subagent_compactor_batch_receipts`, opened through the composition's `storageDomain` facility). Receipts carry their owning parent's session id explicitly, and that id is the authorization: another parent can neither read nor overwrite them, and a forked history never masquerades as receipts this session created. A write is durable the moment the backend confirms it (one record per batch, never overwritten), so receipts survive plugin reloads and host restarts. The host's abort semantics drop a cancelled command's own result — that is exactly why the receipt must be durable. The bare `/subagent-compact` listing appends the caller's latest **unclean** receipt (clean runs were already delivered as their own result), and any receipt — clean or not — comes back by id:
section: Batch: compact every direct child at once

text:
@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Batch: compact every direct child at once：```text
/subagent-compact report <batch-id>
```

A failed receipt write is stated in the returned text (`NOT persisted: …`), never claimed as durable. Record shape is enforced by the domain's zod schema at open time — foreign payloads cannot enter the domain at all.

The parent model can call the same operations through:

```text
compact_subagent({ "session_id": "<subagent-session-id>" })
compact_all_subagents({})   // the batch above, with structured counts
```
section: Batch: compact every direct child at once

text: @local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Batch: compact every direct child at once：You can ask the parent: “Call `compact_subagent` for child session X and report the tool result.” A tool call remains subject to the host's permissions. The batch tool's counts — `total`, `compacted`, `nothing_to_compact`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `not_started` — are structured values from the batch result, never numbers parsed back out of the report text (error lines may contain arbitrary digits).
section: Batch: compact every direct child at once

text: @local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Confirm the result：The command must execute as a command card, rather than appear as an ordinary model message. A successful result identifies the child session, summary sequence, and replaced history items. The tool returns `outcome`, `target_session_id`, `summary_seq`, `replaced_items`, and `replaced_tokens`.

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Confirm the result：`replaced_tokens` estimates the old history that was replaced. It does **not** measure net savings after adding the summary. To measure savings, compare the child's context estimate or total request input before and after compaction. The summary uses one additional model request on the child's own route.

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Confirm the result：Refusals are explicit outcomes, never silent: `unknown-session` (no live or persisted session), `not-authorized` (foreign parent / grandchild / self), `unsupported-target` (one-shot, external, missing or unsupported descriptor), `pending-input` (persisted unfinished input — continue the child instead), `busy-target` (a concurrent compaction or another live writer; retry), `restore-failed`, `query-unavailable`, plus the engine's six manual-compaction codes (`busy`, `cancelled`, `changed`, `summary`, `commit`, `persistence`).

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · Requirements and limits：- The composition must provide `commands`, `tools`, `agents`, and `subagents`, plus a compaction engine for the target child. Normal subagent-capable Desktop presets provide these services. Cold compaction additionally needs `sessionQuery` and session persistence (present in the same compositions). Batch receipts live in the plugin's own storage domain (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`, a required peer; the domain is schema-validated and never model-visible) opened through the composition's `storageDomain` facility; when the facility is absent, or a write fails, the batch text says the receipt was `NOT persisted` instead of claiming durability.
- Only the exact runtime parent can compact its direct child. Other parents, the caller itself, and grandchildren are rejected — for live targets through runtime ownership, for finished targets through the child's persisted header lineage and its durable descriptor.
- Preset compositions resolve the child's engine through `agentPresets.serviceFor` (no Host-plane fallback); compositions without that registry use the Host engine.

text:
@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 使用：在创建子智能体的父会话中输入：

```text
/subagent-compact
```

命令列出持久化的直接子成员目录。每行结尾标注 `— live`（已加载的 agent）或 `— persisted (not loaded)`（仅持久化记录；列表是即时观察，不是预留）。复制完整 session ID，再执行：

```text
/subagent-compact <子智能体的session-id>
```

两种合法情形：

- **子智能体仍 live** —— 在它运行时发起即可；默认 `waitForIdle: true` 会等本轮结束再压缩。
- **子智能体已结束**（已结算、被回收的 continuable 子智能体）—— 之后任意时刻按 id 调用。插件恢复子会话、压缩一次、释放句柄；不会发送新任务。压缩后同一 id 仍可正常续接。

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 批量：一次压缩全部直接子成员：对调用父会话**启动时刻的持久化目录快照**中的每个直接子成员逐个压缩（快照之后新增的成员属于下一次运行；不递归孙成员、不涉及其他父会话的成员）。各项**串行**执行并沿用同一 per-target 锁——并发的单项压缩同一目标会得到 `busy-target`。每一项都单独报告结果与原因（压缩成功含 summary seq / 替换条目数 / 被替换历史 token 估算、无可压历史、one-shot 或 pending 被拒、引擎失败等）；单项失败不会吞掉其余项。批量结果只有在每个子成员都压缩成功或无可压历史时才是 `completed`；全部未成功为 `all-failed`，部分失败为 `partial-failure`，被取消为 `batch-cancelled`——包括取消落在目录读取尚未结束时的情形；这些非干净结果都会让命令报错，绝不报成功。取消（或卸载插件）会停止尚未开始的项（记为 `not-started`）并保留已完成的结果；取消落地时目录已读出的，已知的全部目标都会逐项记为 `not-started`，目录真未读出的则明确报告快照未知。每个被压缩的子成员仍会在自己的模型路由上多一次摘要请求。原版运行时上冷路径项会被拒（`host-capability-missing` 计入 failed），live 项照常压缩。
section: 批量：一次压缩全部直接子成员

text:
@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 批量：一次压缩全部直接子成员：每个完成的批量都会持久化一条**回执**——插件自有版本化**存储域**（`subagent_compactor_batch_receipts`，经组合的 `storageDomain` 设施打开）中一条经 schema 校验的记录。回执显式携带所属父会话 id，该 id 即授权边界：其他父会话读不到也覆盖不了，fork 继承的历史不会冒充本会话自己创建的回执。写入在后端确认落盘的那一刻即持久（每批次一条、绝不覆盖），插件重载、宿主重启后仍在。宿主的 abort 语义会丢弃被取消命令自身的结果——回执必须持久化正是为此。裸 `/subagent-compact` 列表会附上本父最近一条**未干净完成**的回执（干净批次的结果当时已正常送达）；任意回执（干净与否）都可按 id 取回：

```text
/subagent-compact report <batch-id>
```

回执写入失败会在返回文本中如实写明（`NOT persisted: …`），绝不谎称已持久化；记录形状由域的 zod schema 在打开时强制校验——外来载荷根本进不了域。
section: 批量：一次压缩全部直接子成员

text:
@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 批量：一次压缩全部直接子成员：父智能体也可以在回合内调用工具：

```text
compact_subagent({ "session_id": "<子智能体的session-id>" })
compact_all_subagents({})   // 上述批量入口，附结构化计数
```

例如告诉父智能体：“调用 `compact_subagent` 压缩子会话 X，并报告工具返回结果。”工具执行遵循宿主权限设置。批量工具的计数——`total`、`compacted`、`nothing_to_compact`、`failed`、`cancelled`、`not_started`——是批量结果的结构化数值，绝不从报告文本反向解析（错误行里可能出现任意数字）。
section: 批量：一次压缩全部直接子成员

text:
@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 怎么确认压缩成功：带参命令应显示为真正的命令卡片。成功结果会给出子会话 ID、摘要序号和被替换的历史条目数；工具返回 `outcome`、`target_session_id`、`summary_seq`、`replaced_items`、`replaced_tokens`。

`replaced_tokens` 是被替换旧历史的估算量，不是加入摘要后的净节省量。要衡量上下文下降，应比较压缩前后的上下文估算或实际请求总输入。生成摘要会在子智能体自己的路由上多用一次模型请求。

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 怎么确认压缩成功：拒绝都是显式 outcome，不会静默失败：`unknown-session`（无此会话）、`not-authorized`（他人子成员 / 孙成员 / 自身）、`unsupported-target`（one-shot、external、缺失或不受支持的 descriptor）、`pending-input`（存在持久化未处理输入——应先续接子智能体）、`busy-target`（并发压缩或他人持有写入句柄；稍后重试）、`restore-failed`、`query-unavailable`，以及引擎的六个手动压缩错误码（`busy`、`cancelled`、`changed`、`summary`、`commit`、`persistence`）。

@local/dsh-subagent-compactor README · 环境与边界：- 组合需要 `commands`、`tools`、`agents`、`subagents` 服务，以及子成员对应的压缩引擎；冷压缩另需 `sessionQuery` 与会话持久化（同类组合中通常已具备）。批量回执存放在插件自有的存储域（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`，新增必需 peer；域内记录经 schema 校验、不进模型可见面），经组合的 `storageDomain` 设施打开；设施缺失或写入失败时，批量文本会如实写 `NOT persisted`，绝不谎称已持久化。
- 只允许运行时直接父级操作。live 目标按运行时所有权拒绝他人；已结束目标按子会话持久化 header 的父级血缘与其持久 descriptor 拒绝他人子成员、自身和孙成员。
- preset 组合通过 `agentPresets.serviceFor` 解析子成员引擎（绝不回退 Host 平面）；无该注册表的组合使用 Host 引擎。
- 冷压缩依赖宿主的管理器侧维护能力（`ctx.subagents.runMaintenance`）。在原版 0.2.1-rc.2 运行时上，插件会明确拒绝冷压缩（`host-capability-missing`）；[host-patch/](host-patch/README.md) 中的隔离候选宿主补丁提供该能力：已接受输入不丢失、正常续接全程可用、仅卸载插件不损滞留输入。live 窗口压缩在两种运行时上都可用。
- 支持列目录和手动压缩；删除、handoff、自动触发不在此版本范围内。
- 已验证 Desktop `0.12.1` / Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`；其他版本需要另行验证。
